description: This file is a PHP template responsible for rendering a 'channel call' page, including layout setup, metadata, and inserting various partial templates related to the call's details, projects, stories, resources, and team.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Sets the overall page layout and metadata.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Defines a section within the layout to insert content.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Includes partial templates into the layout.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces or ends the current section or layout block.
